name: Product Campaign & UGC Video Briefs
body: # FLUX 3 advertising and UGC prompts Six campaign concepts with specific product actions. Synthetic demonstrations are design visualizations, not evidence of real performance or customer experience. ## A01 — Light through linen **Use:** homeware campaign concept **Mode:** image to video · **Format:** 9:16, 15 seconds **Input:** an approved first frame showing the lamp and tabletop **Adjust:** lamp finish only before preparing the reference. ```text Animate the supplied first frame of one unbranded table lamp: pleated cream linen shade, cylindrical terracotta base and one visible black cable. Preserve its exact shape, pleat count and scale. 00:00–00:05 — Camera makes a very slow ten-degree lateral move. Afternoon light grazes the shade; the lamp itself is off. Keep the room and cable stationary. 00:05–00:10 — One adult hand enters from the lower edge and operates the existing inline switch once. Warm light begins inside the shade, with realistic transmission through linen. Exposure changes gradually. 00:10–00:15 — The hand exits along the same path. Camera eases to a stop at the approved three-quarter view. Leave the upper background clear for copy added later. AUDIO: Quiet room, sleeve brushing the table, one small switch click. No electrical surge, music or voice. LOCK: Same cable route, shade seam, contact shadow and tabletop texture. AVOID: duplicated lamp, additional controls, glowing solid base, disappearing cable, energy-saving claims, generated text, logo or watermark. ``` ## A02 — The pocket actually closes **Use:** casual creator product demonstration **Mode:** text to video · **Format:** 9:16, 18 seconds **Adjust:** pouch color and everyday contents; retain the exact item count. ```text One adult creator in a dark green T-shirt stands at an ordinary kitchen counter, demonstrating an unbranded navy zip pouch. Fixed phone framing includes torso, hands and counter. 00:00–00:05 — Show the empty open pouch beside three items: one folded cable, one house key and one lip balm. Creator says in natural English: "These are the things I keep losing." 00:05–00:12 — Place the three items inside separately, then close the existing zipper in one uninterrupted movement. Keep the pouch's modest thickness plausible; do not shrink its contents. 00:12–00:18 — Put the closed pouch in a jacket pocket already hanging from a chair. Creator pats the pocket once and says: "Now they leave together." Hold briefly on the jacket. AUDIO: Untreated room tone, metal key, fabric and zipper. No background song or applause. LOCK: Same hands, zipper orientation, three items, pouch size and chair position. AVOID: hidden edits during packing, extra compartments, invented testimonials, price or capacity claims, subtitles, labels or watermark. ``` ## A03 — The first spoonful **Use:** tactile food advertisement **Mode:** text to video · **Format:** 1:1, 15 seconds **Adjust:** bowl and topping colors; keep the food physics believable. ```text Create a close food-film concept around a shallow cream ceramic bowl containing thick tomato soup, one small basil leaf and a thin swirl of cream. A steel spoon rests on a folded linen napkin. 00:00–00:05 — Locked three-quarter macro view. An adult hand picks up the spoon by its handle. Steam rises gently, not as a dense cloud. 00:05–00:10 — The spoon enters at the near edge and draws one slow arc through the cream. The swirl breaks only where the spoon passes. Lift a small spoonful; one drop falls back into the same spot. 00:10–00:15 — The spoon exits upward. Focus returns to the ripple fading on the surface. Leave a clear, stable end frame. AUDIO: Spoon touching ceramic, a quiet pour-like movement and subtle restaurant room tone. No chewing, speech or score. LOCK: Bowl shape, basil location until fluid moves it, consistent light from frame left and plausible liquid level. AVOID: stretching soup, solid cream ribbons, endless steam, duplicate utensils, generated slogan, menu prices, logo or watermark. ``` ## A04 — One-handed opening, slowly **Use:** product interaction study for a reusable lunch box **Mode:** image to video · **Format:** 16:9, 20 seconds **Input:** approved tabletop frame with the actual closed product **Adjust:** contents after verifying real compartment dimensions. ```text Use the reference as the exact first frame. One rectangular lunch box has two visible side clips and a separate silicone seal in its lid. This is a concept demonstration, not a leakproof test. 00:00–00:06 — Locked overhead shot. One hand releases the left clip; the other releases the right. Each clip remains attached to its hinge. 00:06–00:12 — Lift the lid vertically and place it beside the box, underside visible. Reveal three compartments already filled with ordinary lunch portions; do not generate steam. 00:12–00:17 — Remove one carrot stick from the front compartment. Nothing else changes position. 00:17–00:20 — Hold the open layout, leaving space for post-production annotations. AUDIO: Two distinct latch clicks, soft lid contact and room tone. No voice, score or exaggerated suction. LOCK: Match geometry, clip count, material finish, seal and food quantity. AVOID: self-opening hardware, extra hinges, bending plastic, magical freshness, unsupported claims, text, brand marks or watermark. ``` ## A05 — Repair is the reveal **Use:** repair-service campaign visualization **Mode:** text to video · **Format:** 9:16, 20 seconds **Adjust:** fabric and patch shape; keep the repair visibly modest. ```text Show one worn blue canvas tote on a sewing table. A small rectangular tan patch is already pinned over a tear. Only an adult repairer's hands and forearms appear. 00:00–00:06 — Medium overhead view. Fingers flatten the patch and guide a threaded needle through the first visible stitch. Keep the repair small enough for the frame. 00:06–00:14 — Cut to a close side view after an explicit time jump: most of the seam is now complete. Show the final two stitches and a tied thread. Do not imply the full repair took seconds. 00:14–00:20 — Return to overhead. The repairer removes the pins into a tray, turns the tote upright and rests a hand beside the still-visible patch. AUDIO: Needle through canvas, pin contacts and table creak. No narration or music. LOCK: Same tear location, weave, patch, stitch color and handles. The bag remains used, not restored to a new product. AVOID: unsafe needle placement, disappearing wear, invisible stitches, sustainability statistics, before-and-after proof claims, text, logos or watermark. ``` ## A06 — The quiet last seat **Use:** neighborhood venue campaign **Mode:** text to video · **Format:** 16:9, 18 seconds **Adjust:** venue colors; do not imply a real establishment or offer. ```text Create a fictional neighborhood café scene just before opening. A staff member in a plain brown apron places the final chair at a small window table. No customers or readable signs. 00:00–00:06 — Static medium-wide view. The staff member lifts the wooden chair clear of the floor, turns it a quarter turn and lowers all four legs beside the table. 00:06–00:12 — Move only the camera a little closer as the staff member adjusts a folded napkin and one empty glass. Morning light traces the table edge. 00:12–00:18 — Staff member steps out of frame. Hold the empty welcoming seat with space around it. No one arrives and nothing fills itself. AUDIO: Chair feet, folded cloth, distant coffee grinder from behind camera and quiet street ambience. LOCK: Four chair legs, one glass, one napkin, window position and sunlight direction. AVOID: free-food offers, reservation claims, branded interiors, extra furniture, artificial crowd noise, captions, promotional copy or watermark. ```
description_en: Six advertising and creator-style video briefs (15–20s) built around one specific product action each, with second-by-second timelines and explicit LOCK, AUDIO and AVOID blocks.
description_zh: 六条广告与 UGC 风格的视频简报（15–20 秒），每条围绕一个具体的产品动作展开，带逐秒时间线与明确的 LOCK、AUDIO、AVOID 段落。
long_en: Each brief names its mode (text-to-video or image-to-video), aspect ratio, duration and which detail the user may adjust, then writes the shot as timed ranges — a hand entering to click an inline lamp switch, a pouch closing over a counted set of everyday objects, a lunch box opened one-handed. The LOCK block pins cable routes, seams, contact shadows and object counts across the clip; the AUDIO block specifies diegetic sound only; the AVOID block bans branded interiors, fabricated offers, reservation claims, captions and watermarks. Products are deliberately unbranded, and image-to-video briefs assume an approved first frame.
long_zh: 每条简报先标明生成模式（文生视频或图生视频）、画幅比例、时长与允许调整的细节，再以时间区间写出镜头——一只手入画拨动台灯线控开关、束口袋合上并罩住清点过的日常物件、单手打开便当盒。LOCK 段落锁定电线走向、拼缝、接触阴影与物件数量在全片保持一致；AUDIO 段落只允许画内音；AVOID 段落禁止品牌化室内、虚构优惠、预订承诺、字幕与水印。产品刻意保持无品牌，图生视频类简报默认已有一张审核过的首帧。
sec_note_en: Plain text prompts; no tool access or external calls. Image-to-video briefs require you to supply a first frame you have the rights to. These are untested creative specifications for advertising use — the briefs themselves forbid performance claims and fabricated offers, but any synthetic product footage you publish still needs its own legal and disclosure review. Written and named for FLUX 3, whose availability is staged; the directing structure transfers to other video models but exact behaviour will not. The source repo is run by the commercial API reseller bestimage.ai (host `api.flaq.ai`); these prompt files carry no product placement.
sec_note_zh: 纯文本提示词，不涉及工具调用或外部请求。图生视频类简报需要你自备拥有权利的首帧素材。这些是用于广告场景的未经实测的创作规格——简报本身已禁止效果承诺与虚构优惠，但你实际发布的任何合成产品素材仍需自行完成法务与披露审查。以 FLUX 3 命名与撰写，而该模型分阶段开放；这套导演式结构可迁移到其它视频模型，但具体表现不会一致。来源仓库由商业 API 转售商 bestimage.ai 运营（接口域名 `api.flaq.ai`），不过这些提示词文件没有产品植入。
